macro.reasoning: Temperature has risen from ~22°C in early January to ~26°C in late February, showing a clear warming trend of ~0.1°C/day. Forecast continues the slight cooling trend observed in the last 3 days (26.5→26.2→26.0→26.1) with a gradual decline of ~0.1°C/day toward seasonal norms.

synthesis.reasoning: Both macro and micro forecasts agree on a gradual cooling trend of approximately 0.1°C per day from the current level near 26.1°C. The macro model emphasizes the broader seasonal plateau after a steady January–February warming, while the micro model focuses on the recent tight oscillation around 26°C with a subtle downward drift. Averaging the two nearly identical trajectories yields a consensus forecast that starts at 26.05°C and declines smoothly to 25.45°C over the 7-day horizon. Uncertainty is low given the stable, dry conditions and consistent recent pattern, though a sudden weather system could disrupt the gradual trend.
